description: Defines lock ranks, witness data structures, and inline functions for lock order verification in jemalloc.

classes.name: witness_t
classes.description: Represents a lock witness with name, rank, comparison function, opaque data, and linkage.

classes.name: witness_tsd_t
classes.description: Per-thread data structure holding list of witnesses and forking status.

classes.name: witness_tsdn_t
classes.description: Nullable wrapper for witness_tsd_t for thread-specific data.

methods.name: witness_init
methods.description: Initializes a witness with name, rank, comparison function, and opaque data.

methods.name: witness_lock_error
methods.description: Error handler called on lock order violations.

methods.name: witness_owner_error
methods.description: Error handler called when witness ownership assertion fails.

methods.name: witness_not_owner_error
methods.description: Error handler called when witness is not owner as expected.

methods.name: witness_depth_error
methods.description: Error handler called when lock depth does not match expectations.

methods.name: witness_owner
methods.description: Checks if a witness is owned in the current thread.

methods.name: witness_assert_owner
methods.description: Asserts that a witness is owned, calls error handler if not.

methods.name: witness_assert_not_owner
methods.description: Asserts that a witness is not owned, calls error handler if it is.

methods.name: witness_assert_depth_to_rank
methods.description: Validates the depth of owned witnesses up to a specified rank.

methods.name: witness_assert_depth
methods.description: Validates the depth of owned witnesses from minimum rank.

methods.name: witness_assert_lockless
methods.description: Asserts that no witnesses are owned (depth zero).

methods.name: witness_lock
methods.description: Records ownership of a witness, checking for lock order violations.
